tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
298 RJ45 Pass Through Cat5 Cat5e Cat6 Crimping Tool for RJ45/RJ12 Regular

Professional Must-have Wire Terminal Tool

RJ45 Crimping Tool provides 360 degrees of connector support during the crimping cycle, as it cuts, strips and terminates RJ11/12 and RJ45 extended copper wires with a precision die head.

Ideal for Pass-Through and legacy connectors

Fast and reliable ez crimping tool that crimps RJ45 modular plug for CCTV, Security, media and data communication by upholding a clean cut trims on RJ45/RJ11/12 end-pass-through 8 conductor.

Multifunctional Tool

Full Compatible with Ethernet and phone cables, this all-in-one tool tackles crimping, stripping and cutting of all RJ45 CAT5 CAT5E, CAT6 (including shielded) and RJ11/12 connectors (not AMP).

Long-lasting durability and Easy of use

Hardened Steel Contruction is durable and delivers more torque during the crimping cycle, die head assembly provides 360 degrees of connector support for terminating modular plugs on stranded or solid cable
